title: MNIST: inside a convolutional network
description: Follow a handwritten digit through learned filters, pooling and classification.
alt: A real MNIST digit passes through computed convolutional feature maps, ReLU, pooling and a ten-class prediction on a black background.

requirements.description: Use the trained 4-filter / 8-filter CNN and real MNIST test image 0, with frozen weights, computed activations and reproducible provenance; no training depicted.
Enlarge an actual patch and learned kernel, reveal products/sum/bias, ReLU including a negative example, and scan one full activation map with shared weights and zero padding.

Show all four first-layer maps, an exact 2x2 pooling maximum, channel-summed second convolution with eight maps, pooling, 392-feature flattening, ten logits, softmax probabilities, sample loss and measured test accuracy.

Polished black-background technical animation, one focused calculation at a time, smooth motion, readable typography, LaTeX mathematics and Arial-family prose; 1080p30 H264 video and useful thumbnail. Short website description.
